interface.title: OAS Spectrum Studio (OAS Studio v1.3, Optical Absorption Spectroscopy)
interface.field: Atmospheric / plasma chemistry — UV optical absorption spectroscopy of reactive nitrogen and oxygen species
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis of measured data: turning raw spectra into calibrated species number densities, judging how good the fit is, and exporting the results
interface.what_it_is_for: Upload a reference (I0) and measured absorption spectrum, or a time-series sharing one I0, and break the optical depth down into number densities for 8 species (HONO, HONO2, N2O4, N2O5, NO, NO2, NO3, O3), with fit metrics, a validation overlay and CSV export.

data.note: Single mode used reference.txt as I0 and measured.txt as It. Time-series mode used Source_70_2_00000/00001/00002.txt; the lowest suffix was taken as I0, which gave 2 timepoints. Analysis is blocked until the user ticks a consent box to contribute the data to a 'global model'. With no submission endpoint configured, each run showed 'Auto-save skipped — submission endpoint not configured', so no data left the machine. The first page loads were blank for a while until the app finished starting.
